addresses.label: Assist Mode Colors
addresses.notes: Packed varint repeated uint32 (ArrayOf5Uint32), confirmed against com.bosch.ebike.messagebus.MessageBus$DriveUnit.assistModeColors in Flow decompile. Each uint32 packs R<<24|G<<16|B<<8|A - alpha LAST, not Android's conventional ARGB. Confirmed empirically: every real mode decodes to full alpha (0xff) only with this byte order; the alpha-first reading gave implausible, inconsistent per-mode alpha values instead.
